verdict: key consistent once the plaintext is re-read from the cipher: 129 signs against 130 letters, 128 of 129 aligned signs on their key letter (99.2% over repeated shapes, skeleton 99.2%). The system is a simple substitution with homophones: two shapes each for د (C-ball and ٣, as the compiler says: 'he made the dal in two forms'), ذ, م, و and س, three for ل. Against the record's low-certainty reading the fit is only 87%; the record's unread middle words are read here from the cipher.
notes: Plaintext AS ENCIPHERED (by eye): يا من يفك الرمز فك الذي اقوله من غير اعيا / ما ذات قد رمق اهيف تاتيك في صبح وامسا / منكوسه الراس كم حزونه قد دقها الدهر بارزا / ترزق بالنار فراخا لها من بعد ما يسقون بالما ('O you who solve riddles, solve what I say without tiring: what is she, of slender stature, who comes to you morning and evening, head turned down, how rough she is! Time has struck her with misfortunes; she is given chicks by fire, after they water her with water' - the cooking pot).

Departures from the record's reading of 18v l.12-14: بامر ففك -> يا من يفك; ماذات[?] قد[?] رشو[?] هيف[?] ثابتا في صح -> ما ذات قد رمق اهيف تاتيك في صبح (the word رمق is the cipher's: ر, the م of وامسا, ق; not checked against the master); the interlinear وامسا (record: possibly وامسا) is part of the line; لحزونه -> كم حزونه; بالاناء -> بارزا (the master reads بارزاء); مر -> من (the cipher writes the 4-ayn ر sign here: the one mismatch); يسوز -> يسقون. Hamza is never enciphered (اعيا, بارزا, بالما).
One dropped letter: ترزق is enciphered X Z3 Wq (ت ز ق), without ر.
Dividers: 30 groups for 36 words; the compiler's remark 'he left out many separators' fits: فك الذي, ذات قد, كم حزونه, قد دقها and others are run together; the divider count is not a word count here.
Counts by eye: 18r l.11-13 = 12, 11, 10; 18v l.1-9 = 12, 13, 9, 12, 13, 11, 12, 12, 3 (129; the record's 133 is the segmenter's). 18v l.3 and l.6 are cipher (the segmenter classed them Arabic).
Shape doubts: Sl and Sk (both ل) may be one slashed shape drawn two ways; SH3 and Lh (both و) may be one; Tb is م in رمق and وامسا while T3 is م everywhere else.
